arguments.sql:
SELECT d."XCL_018"
FROM district AS d
WHERE d."XCL_019" = 'north Bohemia'
  AND (
    SELECT SUM(t."XCL_051")
    FROM trans AS t
    WHERE t."XCL_047" IN (SELECT a."XCL_001" FROM account AS a WHERE a."XCL_002" = d."XCL_017")
      AND t."XCL_049" = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t."XCL_055" IS NULL
      AND t."XCL_048" LIKE '1997%'
  ) > 15000
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account AS a2
    INNER JOIN loan AS l ON a2."XCL_001" = l."XCL_034"
    WHERE a2."XCL_002" = d."XCL_017"
      AND a2."XCL_003" = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
      AND l."XCL_036" >= 200000
      AND l."XCL_035" BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  )

SELECT d."XCL_018"
FROM district AS d
WHERE d."XCL_019" = 'north Bohemia'
  AND d."XCL_017" IN (
    SELECT a."XCL_002"
    FROM account AS a
    INNER JOIN trans AS t ON a."XCL_001" = t."XCL_047"
    WHERE t."XCL_049" = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t."XCL_055" IS NULL
      AND t."XCL_048" LIKE '1997%'
    GROUP BY a."XCL_002"
    HAVING SUM(t."XCL_051") > 15000
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account AS a2
    INNER JOIN loan AS l ON a2."XCL_001" = l."XCL_034"
    WHERE a2."XCL_002" = d."XCL_017"
      AND a2."XCL_003" = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
      AND l."XCL_036" >= 200000
      AND l."XCL_035" BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  )

SELECT d."XCL_018"
FROM district AS d
WHERE d."XCL_019" = 'north Bohemia'
  AND d."XCL_017" IN (
    SELECT a."XCL_002"
    FROM account AS a
    INNER JOIN trans AS t ON a."XCL_001" = t."XCL_047"
    WHERE t."XCL_049" = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t."XCL_055" IS NULL
      AND t."XCL_048" LIKE '1997%'
    GROUP BY a."XCL_002"
    HAVING SUM(t."XCL_051") > 15000
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account AS a2
    INNER JOIN loan AS l ON a2."XCL_001" = l."XCL_034"
    WHERE a2."XCL_002" = d."XCL_017"
      AND a2."XCL_003" = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
      AND l."XCL_036" >= 200000
      AND l."XCL_035" BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  )
